-- Complete solution: fit regression, predict, compute moving averages, sum
WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series('2017-01-01'::DATE, '2018-08-29'::DATE, '1 day'::INTERVAL)) as sale_date
),
daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) as sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) as daily_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
    WHERE pct.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= '2017-01-01'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
),
daily_with_daynum AS (
    SELECT 
        d.sale_date,
        COALESCE(ds.daily_sales, 0) as daily_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d.sale_date) as day_num
    FROM date_range d
    LEFT JOIN daily_sales ds ON d.sale_date = ds.sale_date
),
regression_params AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_num) as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_num) as intercept
    FROM daily_with_daynum
),
predictions AS (
    SELECT 
        day_num,
        sale_date,
        r.slope * CAST(day_num AS DOUBLE) + r.intercept as predicted_sales
    FROM (
        SELECT 702 as day_num, '2018-12-03' as sale_date
        UNION ALL SELECT 703, '2018-12-04'
        UNION ALL SELECT 704, '2018-12-05'
        UNION ALL SELECT 705, '2018-12-06'
        UNION ALL SELECT 706, '2018-12-07'
        UNION ALL SELECT 707, '2018-12-08'
        UNION ALL SELECT 708, '2018-12-09'
        UNION ALL SELECT 709, '2018-12-10'
    ) dates
    CROSS JOIN regression_params r
),
moving_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        p.sale_date as center_date,
        AVG(pred.predicted_sales) as moving_avg_5day
    FROM predictions p
    JOIN predictions pred ON pred.day_num BETWEEN p.day_num - 2 AND p.day_num + 2
    WHERE p.day_num IN (704, 705, 706, 707)
    GROUP BY p.sale_date
)
SELECT SUM(moving_avg_5day) as sum_of_moving_averages
FROM moving_averages

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        COALESCE(SUM(op.payment_value), 0) AS order_total
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id, o.order_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp
),
customer_rfm AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        CAST(DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)), CAST('2018-10-17 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) AS recency_days,
        COUNT(*) AS frequency,
        SUM(order_total) AS monetary,
        SUM(order_total) / COUNT(*) AS avg_sales_per_order
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
rfm_scored AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        recency_days,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        avg_sales_per_order,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days DESC) AS r_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency ASC) AS f_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary ASC) AS m_score
    FROM customer_rfm
),
rfm_with_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        recency_days,
        r_score,
        f_score,
        m_score,
        CAST(r_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(f_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(m_score AS VARCHAR) AS rfm_cell,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        avg_sales_per_order,
        CASE 
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN r_score IN (2, 3) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6) 
              OR (r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS rfm_segment
    FROM rfm_scored
)
SELECT 
    rfm_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_sales_per_order), 2) AS avg_sales_per_order,
    ROUND(AVG(monetary), 2) AS avg_monetary,
    ROUND(AVG(frequency), 2) AS avg_frequency,
    ROUND(AVG(recency_days), 2) AS avg_recency_days
FROM rfm_with_segment
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC

-- Build the full query
WITH customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    o.customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as num_orders,
    SUM(op.payment_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as avg_payment_per_order
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
top3 AS (
  SELECT customer_id, num_orders, avg_payment_per_order
  FROM customer_metrics
  ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
  t.customer_id,
  t.num_orders,
  t.avg_payment_per_order,
  GREATEST(
    (CAST(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) - CAST(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE)) / 7.0,
    1.0
  ) as lifespan_weeks
FROM top3 t
JOIN orders o ON t.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY t.customer_id, t.num_orders, t.avg_payment_per_order
ORDER BY t.avg_payment_per_order DESC

WITH player_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    CAST(debut AS DATE) as debut_date,
    CAST(final_game AS DATE) as final_date
  FROM player 
  WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND debut != '' AND final_game IS NOT NULL AND final_game != ''
),
raw_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM final_date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM debut_date) as raw_y,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM final_date) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM debut_date) as raw_m,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM final_date) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM debut_date) as raw_d,
    final_date
  FROM player_dates
),
day_adjusted AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    raw_y,
    raw_m,
    raw_d,
    CASE WHEN raw_d < 0 THEN raw_m - 1 ELSE raw_m END as m_adj,
    CASE WHEN raw_d < 0 THEN raw_d + CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (DATE_TRUNC('month', final_date) - INTERVAL '1 day')) AS INTEGER) ELSE raw_d END as d_adj
  FROM raw_diff
),
final_adjusted AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    CASE WHEN m_adj < 0 THEN raw_y - 1 ELSE raw_y END as y_final,
    CASE WHEN m_adj < 0 THEN m_adj + 12 ELSE m_adj END as m_final,
    d_adj as d_final
  FROM day_adjusted
),
career_spans AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    ROUND(ABS(y_final::DOUBLE), 2) + ROUND(ABS(m_final::DOUBLE) / 12, 2) + ROUND(ABS(d_final::DOUBLE) / 365, 2) as career_span
  FROM final_adjusted
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(career_span), 2) as avg_career_span
FROM career_spans

WITH career_stats AS (SELECT player_id, TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(g AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT) as total_g, TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(r AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT) as total_r, TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(h AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT) as total_h, TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(hr AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT) as total_hr FROM batting WHERE TRY_CAST(g AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id), leaders AS (SELECT 'games_played' as category, player_id, total_g as value FROM career_stats QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_g DESC) = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'runs', player_id, total_r FROM career_stats QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_r DESC) = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'hits', player_id, total_h FROM career_stats QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_h DESC) = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'home_runs', player_id, total_hr FROM career_stats QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_hr DESC) = 1) SELECT l.category, p.name_given, l.value FROM leaders l JOIN player p ON l.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY l.category

WITH abakan_routes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport,
           CAST(ad_dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR) AS dep_coords,
           CAST(ad_arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR) AS arr_coords
    FROM flights f
    JOIN airports_data ad_dep ON f.departure_airport = ad_dep.airport_code
    JOIN airports_data ad_arr ON f.arrival_airport = ad_arr.airport_code
    WHERE ad_dep.city LIKE '%Abakan%' OR ad_arr.city LIKE '%Abakan%'
),
parsed AS (
    SELECT *,
           TRY_CAST(TRIM(BOTH '(' FROM SPLIT_PART(dep_coords, ',', 1)) AS DOUBLE) AS dep_lon,
           TRY_CAST(TRIM(BOTH ')' FROM SPLIT_PART(dep_coords, ',', 2)) AS DOUBLE) AS dep_lat,
           TRY_CAST(TRIM(BOTH '(' FROM SPLIT_PART(arr_coords, ',', 1)) AS DOUBLE) AS arr_lon,
           TRY_CAST(TRIM(BOTH ')' FROM SPLIT_PART(arr_coords, ',', 2)) AS DOUBLE) AS arr_lat
    FROM abakan_routes
),
haversine AS (
    SELECT 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
               POW(SIN((arr_lat - dep_lat) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2) +
               COS(dep_lat * PI() / 180) * COS(arr_lat * PI() / 180) *
               POW(SIN((arr_lon - dep_lon) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
           )) AS distance_km
    FROM parsed
)
SELECT ROUND(MAX(distance_km), 2) AS longest_route_distance_km
FROM haversine

WITH flight_airports AS (
  SELECT 
    f.departure_airport,
    f.arrival_airport,
    dep.city->>'en' as dep_city,
    arr.city->>'en' as arr_city,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(dep.coordinates::VARCHAR, '(', 2), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) as dep_lon,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(dep.coordinates::VARCHAR, ',', 2), ')', 1) AS DOUBLE) as dep_lat,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(arr.coordinates::VARCHAR, '(', 2), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) as arr_lon,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(arr.coordinates::VARCHAR, ',', 2), ')', 1) AS DOUBLE) as arr_lat
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airports_data dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airports_data arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
),
distances AS (
  SELECT 
    dep_city,
    arr_city,
    (2 * 6371 * ASIN(SQRT(
      POWER(SIN(RADIANS(dep_lat - arr_lat) / 2), 2) +
      COS(RADIANS(dep_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(arr_lat)) *
      POWER(SIN(RADIANS(dep_lon - arr_lon) / 2), 2)
    ))) as distance_km
  FROM flight_airports
),
city_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    LEAST(dep_city, arr_city) as city1,
    GREATEST(dep_city, arr_city) as city2,
    distance_km
  FROM distances
),
avg_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    AVG(distance_km) as avg_distance
  FROM city_pairs
  GROUP BY city1, city2
),
categorized AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    avg_distance,
    CASE 
      WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0'
      WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000'
      ELSE '6000+'
    END as distance_range
  FROM avg_distances
),
range_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    distance_range,
    COUNT(*) as num_pairs
  FROM categorized
  GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT num_pairs
FROM range_counts
ORDER BY num_pairs ASC
LIMIT 1

-- Final simplified query
WITH helmet_used_collisions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.case_id
  FROM parties p
  WHERE p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet used%' 
     OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet used%'
),
helmet_not_used_collisions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.case_id
  FROM parties p
  WHERE p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet not used%' 
     OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet not used%'
),
motorcyclist_fatalities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.case_id
  FROM parties p
  WHERE p.statewide_vehicle_type = 'motorcycle or scooter'
    AND p.party_number_killed > 0
)
SELECT 
  'helmet used' as helmet_usage_group,
  ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN mf.case_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) as fatality_rate_pct
FROM helmet_used_collisions huc
LEFT JOIN motorcyclist_fatalities mf ON huc.case_id = mf.case_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'helmet not used' as helmet_usage_group,
  ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN mf.case_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) as fatality_rate_pct
FROM helmet_not_used_collisions hnc
LEFT JOIN motorcyclist_fatalities mf ON hnc.case_id = mf.case_id

WITH year_top2 AS (
  SELECT 
    ci.db_year,
    c.pcf_violation_category,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ci.db_year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
  FROM collisions c
  JOIN case_ids ci ON c.case_id = ci.case_id
  WHERE c.pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL 
    AND c.pcf_violation_category != ''
  GROUP BY ci.db_year, c.pcf_violation_category
),
top2_years AS (
  SELECT db_year, STRING_AGG(pcf_violation_category, ',' ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS top2_causes
  FROM year_top2
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY db_year
)
SELECT * FROM top2_years ORDER BY db_year;

SELECT DISTINCT
    b.name AS belt_name,
    w1.name AS winner_name,
    w2.name AS loser_name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Belts b ON m.title_id = CAST(b.id AS TEXT)
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = w1.id
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = w2.id
WHERE b.name LIKE '%NXT%'
  AND m.title_change = 0
  AND m.duration != ''
  AND CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.duration, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.duration, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) = 43

-- Let's verify the top 3 with integer casting and player names
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler, 
           SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) as over_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
        ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler
),
match_max AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(over_runs) as match_max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_over_bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT o.match_id, o.over_id, o.innings_no, o.bowler, o.over_runs, m.match_max_runs
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN match_max m ON o.match_id = m.match_id AND o.over_runs = m.match_max_runs
),
bowler_match_max AS (
    SELECT bowler, match_id, MAX(over_runs) as max_runs_in_match
    FROM max_over_bowler_runs
    GROUP BY bowler, match_id
),
bowler_overall_max AS (
    SELECT bowler, match_id, max_runs_in_match
    FROM bowler_match_max
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY max_runs_in_match DESC, match_id ASC) = 1
)
SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, bom.match_id, CAST(bom.max_runs_in_match AS INTEGER) as runs_conceded
FROM bowler_overall_max bom
JOIN player p ON bom.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bom.max_runs_in_match DESC
LIMIT 3

-- All bowlers with 0.0 bowling average
WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_from_bat
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_extras AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, SUM(er.extra_runs) as extra_runs_charged
    FROM extra_runs er
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON er.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND er.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND er.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND er.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    WHERE er.extra_type IN ('wides', 'noballs', 'penalty')
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND wt.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
)
SELECT 
    br.bowler,
    p.player_name,
    bw.wickets,
    br.runs_from_bat + COALESCE(be.extra_runs_charged, 0) as total_runs_conceded,
    ROUND(1.0 * (br.runs_from_bat + COALESCE(be.extra_runs_charged, 0)) / bw.wickets, 2) as bowling_average
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
LEFT JOIN bowler_extras be ON br.bowler = be.bowler
LEFT JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 10

-- Step 2: For each qualifying striker, compute their total runs across ALL matches (as striker)
WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker, b.match_id, b.innings_no, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs 
      ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
     AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
     AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
     AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id, b.innings_no
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM striker_match_runs
    WHERE total_runs > 50
),
striker_totals AS (
    SELECT smr.striker, SUM(smr.total_runs) as grand_total
    FROM striker_match_runs smr
    WHERE smr.striker IN (SELECT striker FROM qualifying_strikers)
    GROUP BY smr.striker
)
SELECT AVG(grand_total) as average_total_runs
FROM striker_totals

-- Check distinct player count and names again
WITH player_match_runs AS (
  SELECT 
    bbb.match_id,
    bbb.striker AS player_id,
    bbb.team_batting AS team_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball bbb
  JOIN batsman_scored bs 
    ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id 
    AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id 
    AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
    AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  GROUP BY bbb.match_id, bbb.striker, bbb.team_batting
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, p.player_id, pmr.total_runs
FROM player_match_runs pmr
JOIN match m ON pmr.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON pmr.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE pmr.total_runs >= 100
  AND pmr.team_id != m.match_winner
ORDER BY p.player_name

WITH season5_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs 
      ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id 
      AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id 
      AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
      AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bbb.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY bbb.striker
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT wt.player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as dismissal_count
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    WHERE wt.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY wt.player_out
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    WHERE pm.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    ROUND(pr.total_runs * 1.0 / pm.matches_played, 2) as avg_runs_per_match,
    ROUND(pr.total_runs * 1.0 / pd.dismissal_count, 2) as batting_average
FROM player_matches pm
JOIN player_runs pr ON pm.player_id = pr.player_id
JOIN player p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN player_dismissals pd ON pm.player_id = pd.player_id
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5
SELECT SUM(run) as total_batsman_runs FROM (SELECT SUM(bs.runs_scored) as run FROM batsman_scored bs)

-- Final query: average of highest over totals across all matches
WITH over_totals AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_over_runs,
           MIN(b.bowler) as bowler
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_over_runs, bowler,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_over_runs DESC, innings_no ASC, over_id ASC) as rn
    FROM over_totals
)
SELECT AVG(total_over_runs) as avg_highest_over_runs
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

WITH monthly_delivered AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
    CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) AS year_num,
    COUNT(*) AS delivered_count
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)

),
all_months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month_num UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
  UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 
  UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
)

    WHEN 2 THEN 'February'

    WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'June'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'July'
    WHEN 8 THEN 'August'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'September'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'October'

    WHEN 12 THEN 'December'

  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN md.year_num = 2017 THEN md.delivered_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS "2017",

WITH distinct_geolocations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        geolocation_state,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng
    FROM olist_geolocation
),
ordered_geolocations AS (
    SELECT 
        geolocation_state,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng,
        LAG(geolocation_state) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_state,
        LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_city,
        LAG(geolocation_zip_code_prefix) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_zip,
        LAG(geolocation_lat) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lat,
        LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lng
    FROM distinct_geolocations
),
with_distances AS (
    SELECT 
        prev_state, prev_city, prev_zip AS prev_zip_code_prefix, prev_lat, prev_lng,
        geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng,
        6371 * ACOS(
            GREATEST(-1, LEAST(1,
                COS(prev_lat * PI() / 180) * COS(geolocation_lat * PI() / 180) * COS((geolocation_lng - prev_lng) * PI() / 180) 
                + SIN(prev_lat * PI() / 180) * SIN(geolocation_lat * PI() / 180)
            ))
        ) AS distance_km
    FROM ordered_geolocations
    WHERE prev_lat IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    prev_state AS state1,
    prev_city AS city1,
    prev_zip_code_prefix AS zip_code_prefix1,
    prev_lat AS lat1,
    prev_lng AS lng1,
    geolocation_state AS state2,
    geolocation_city AS city2,
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip_code_prefix2,
    geolocation_lat AS lat2,
    geolocation_lng AS lng2,
    distance_km
FROM with_distances
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 1

    )::INT AS running_total

with_lag AS (
  SELECT 
    year,

    ELSE NULL 
  END AS monthly_growth_pct,

WITH daily_net AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date::DATE as txn_date, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                    ELSE 0 END) as net_amount
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date::DATE
),
customer_ranges AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
           MIN(txn_date)::DATE as earliest_date, 
           MAX(txn_date)::DATE as latest_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT cr.customer_id, UNNEST(generate_series(cr.earliest_date, cr.latest_date, INTERVAL '1' DAY)) as cal_date
    FROM customer_ranges cr
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT ad.customer_id, ad.cal_date, 
           COALESCE(dn.net_amount, 0) as daily_change
    FROM all_dates ad
    LEFT JOIN daily_net dn ON ad.customer_id = dn.customer_id AND ad.cal_date = dn.txn_date
),
cumulative_balances AS (
    SELECT customer_id, cal_date, daily_change,
           SUM(daily_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY cal_date) as raw_balance
    FROM daily_balances
),
clamped_balances AS (
    SELECT customer_id, cal_date, 
           GREATEST(raw_balance, 0) as daily_balance
    FROM cumulative_balances
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
           DATE_TRUNC('month', cal_date) as month,
           MAX(daily_balance) as max_daily_balance
    FROM clamped_balances
    GROUP BY customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', cal_date)
)

FROM monthly_max

    GROUP BY ph.product_id
),
added AS (
    SELECT ph.product_id, COUNT(*) as added_to_cart_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE e.event_type = 2
      AND ph.product_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ph.product_id
),
left_in_cart AS (
    SELECT ph.product_id, COUNT(*) as left_in_cart_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE e.event_type = 2
      AND ph.product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND e.visit_id NOT IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM shopping_cart_events WHERE event_type = 3
      )
    GROUP BY ph.product_id
),
purchased AS (
    SELECT ph.product_id, COUNT(*) as purchase_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE e.event_type = 2
      AND ph.product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND e.visit_id IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM shopping_cart_events WHERE event_type = 3
      )
    GROUP BY ph.product_id
)
SELECT 
    v.product_id,
    v.view_count AS views,
    a.added_to_cart_count AS added_to_cart,
    l.left_in_cart_count AS left_in_cart,
    p.purchase_count AS purchases
FROM viewed v
JOIN added a ON v.product_id = a.product_id
JOIN left_in_cart l ON v.product_id = l.product_id
JOIN purchased p ON v.product_id = p.product_id
ORDER BY v.product_id

WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, composition, index_value, 
           AVG(composition / index_value) AS avg_composition
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE month_year IN ('09-2018','10-2018','11-2018','12-2018','01-2019','02-2019','03-2019','04-2019','05-2019','06-2019','07-2019','08-2019')
      AND month_year IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY month_year, interest_id, composition, index_value
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, avg_composition,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition DESC) as rn
    FROM monthly_avg
),
top_per_month AS (
    SELECT r.month_year, r.interest_id, r.avg_composition AS max_index_composition,
           CAST(SUBSTR(r.month_year, 5, 4) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(r.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) AS sort_key
    FROM ranked r
    WHERE r.rn = 1
),
with_lags AS (
    SELECT 
        tpm.month_year,
        im.interest_name,
        tpm.max_index_composition,
        tpm.sort_key,
        AVG(tpm.max_index_composition) OVER (ORDER BY tpm.sort_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_3m,
        LAG(im.interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY tpm.sort_key) AS prev_month_interest,
        LAG(tpm.max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY tpm.sort_key) AS prev_month_composition,
        LAG(im.interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY tpm.sort_key) AS prev_prev_month_interest,
        LAG(tpm.max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY tpm.sort_key) AS prev_prev_month_composition
    FROM top_per_month tpm
    JOIN interest_map im ON tpm.interest_id = im.id
)
SELECT 
    month_year,
    interest_name,
    max_index_composition,
    rolling_avg_3m,
    prev_month_interest,
    prev_month_composition,
    prev_prev_month_interest,
    prev_prev_month_composition
FROM with_lags
ORDER BY sort_key

-- Final query: top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories by highest composition value
WITH peak_composition AS (
    SELECT im.interest_id, im.month_year, im.composition,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY im.interest_id 
               ORDER BY im.composition DESC, im.month_year ASC
           ) as rn
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE im.month_year IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_peaks AS (
    SELECT pc.interest_id, pc.month_year, pc.composition
    FROM peak_composition pc
    WHERE pc.rn = 1
),
top10 AS (
    SELECT rp.interest_id, rp.month_year, rp.composition
    FROM ranked_peaks rp
    ORDER BY rp.composition DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
bottom10 AS (
    SELECT rp.interest_id, rp.month_year, rp.composition
    FROM ranked_peaks rp
    ORDER BY rp.composition ASC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT t.month_year as time, im.interest_name, t.composition
FROM top10 t
JOIN interest_map im ON t.interest_id = CAST(im.id AS DOUBLE)
UNION ALL
SELECT b.month_year as time, im.interest_name, b.composition
FROM bottom10 b
JOIN interest_map im ON b.interest_id = CAST(im.id AS DOUBLE)
ORDER BY composition DESC

    FROM salesorderheader
    WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL AND salespersonid != ''
    GROUP BY TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(orderdate::TEXT, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
),
annual_quota AS (
    SELECT 
        TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS INTEGER) as businessentityid,
        CAST(SUBSTR(QuotaDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(SalesQuota AS DOUBLE)) AS DOUBLE) as annual_quota
    FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
    GROUP BY TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(QuotaDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(s.businessentityid, q.businessentityid) as businessentityid,
        COALESCE(s.year, q.year) as year,
        COALESCE(s.annual_sales, 0) as annual_sales,
        COALESCE(q.annual_quota, 0) as annual_quota,
        COALESCE(s.annual_sales, 0) - COALESCE(q.annual_quota, 0) as difference
    FROM annual_sales s
    FULL OUTER JOIN annual_quota q ON s.businessentityid = q.businessentityid AND s.year = q.year
)
SELECT 
    businessentityid,
    year,

FROM combined

WITH base AS (

    m.region,

    bt.quantity,
    bp.price,
    bt.quantity * bp.price as dollar_amount
  FROM bitcoin_transactions bt
  JOIN bitcoin_members m ON bt.member_id = m.member_id
  JOIN bitcoin_prices bp ON TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(bt.txn_date, '-', 3) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(bt.txn_date, '-', 2) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(bt.txn_date, '-', 1) AS DATE) = TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(bp.market_date, '-', 3) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(bp.market_date, '-', 2) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(bp.market_date, '-', 1) AS DATE)
  WHERE bt.ticker = 'BTC' AND bt.txn_type = 'BUY'
),
annual AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    year,
    SUM(dollar_amount) as total_dollar,
    SUM(quantity) as total_quantity,
    SUM(dollar_amount) * 1.0 / SUM(quantity) as avg_purchase_price
  FROM base
  GROUP BY region, year
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    year,
    avg_purchase_price,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY avg_purchase_price DESC) as price_rank
  FROM annual
  WHERE year != (SELECT MIN(year) FROM annual a2 WHERE a2.region = annual.region)
),
with_change AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    year,
    avg_purchase_price,
    price_rank,
    ROUND(
      (avg_purchase_price - LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY year)) 
      * 100.0 / LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY year), 2
    ) as pct_change
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT 
  region,
  year,
  ROUND(avg_purchase_price, 2) as avg_purchase_price,
  price_rank,
  pct_change
FROM with_change
ORDER BY year, price_rank

WITH parsed AS (

    ticker,

    CASE 
      WHEN volume = '-' THEN 0
      WHEN volume LIKE '%M' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'M', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000000
      WHEN volume LIKE '%K' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'K', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000
      ELSE TRY_CAST(volume AS DOUBLE)
    END AS volume_numeric
  FROM bitcoin_prices
  WHERE market_date IN ('01-08-2021','02-08-2021','03-08-2021','04-08-2021','05-08-2021','06-08-2021','07-08-2021','08-08-2021','09-08-2021','10-08-2021')
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    market_date,
    volume,
    volume_numeric,
    LAG(volume_numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY market_date) AS prev_volume
  FROM parsed
)
SELECT 
  ticker,
  market_date,
  ROUND(
    CASE 
      WHEN prev_volume IS NOT NULL AND prev_volume > 0 
      THEN (volume_numeric - prev_volume) * 100.0 / prev_volume
      ELSE NULL

  ) AS daily_pct_change
FROM with_prev

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lt.id_bioguide, lt.term_start AS initial_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
      AND lt.term_start >= '1917-01-01'
      AND lt.term_start <= '1999-12-31'
),
year_numbers AS (
    SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) AS year_num
    FROM UNNEST(generate_series(1, 20)) AS t(value)
),
legislator_year AS (
    SELECT 
        c.id_bioguide,
        c.initial_term_start,
        yn.year_num,
        make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.initial_term_start::DATE)::INTEGER + yn.year_num, 12, 31) AS check_date
    FROM cohort c
    CROSS JOIN year_numbers yn
),
retained AS (
    SELECT 
        ly.year_num,
        ly.id_bioguide,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM legislators_terms lt2
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ly.id_bioguide
              AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ly.check_date
              AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ly.check_date
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_retained
    FROM legislator_year ly
)
SELECT 
    r.year_num,
    1.0 * SUM(r.is_retained) / 4033 AS retention_rate
FROM retained r
GROUP BY r.year_num
ORDER BY r.year_num

WITH la_male_first AS (

dec31_dates AS (

serving_check AS (

WITH first_terms AS (
  SELECT lt.id_bioguide, lt.term_start::DATE as first_term_start, lt.state, l.gender,
    date_trunc('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + (0 * INTERVAL '1 YEAR') + INTERVAL '1 YEAR' - INTERVAL '1 DAY' as check_date_0,
    date_trunc('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + (2 * INTERVAL '1 YEAR') + INTERVAL '1 YEAR' - INTERVAL '1 DAY' as check_date_2,
    date_trunc('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + (4 * INTERVAL '1 YEAR') + INTERVAL '1 YEAR' - INTERVAL '1 DAY' as check_date_4,
    date_trunc('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + (6 * INTERVAL '1 YEAR') + INTERVAL '1 YEAR' - INTERVAL '1 DAY' as check_date_6,
    date_trunc('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + (8 * INTERVAL '1 YEAR') + INTERVAL '1 YEAR' - INTERVAL '1 DAY' as check_date_8,
    date_trunc('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + (10 * INTERVAL '1 YEAR') + INTERVAL '1 YEAR' - INTERVAL '1 DAY' as check_date_10
  FROM legislators_terms lt
  JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
  WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
retained AS (
  SELECT ft.id_bioguide, ft.state, ft.gender,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
      AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_date_0 AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_date_0) as retained_0,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
      AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_date_2 AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_date_2) as retained_2,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
      AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_date_4 AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_date_4) as retained_4,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
      AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_date_6 AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_date_6) as retained_6,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
      AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_date_8 AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_date_8) as retained_8,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
      AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_date_10 AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_date_10) as retained_10
  FROM first_terms ft
),
retention_rates AS (
  SELECT state, gender,
    SUM(CASE WHEN retained_0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_0_count,
    COUNT(*) as total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN retained_2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_2_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN retained_4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_4_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN retained_6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_6_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN retained_8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_8_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN retained_10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_10_count
  FROM retained
  GROUP BY state, gender
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT state, gender,
    CASE WHEN total > 0 AND retained_0_count > 0 AND retained_2_count > 0 AND retained_4_count > 0 
        AND retained_6_count > 0 AND retained_8_count > 0 AND retained_10_count > 0 
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as all_nonzero
  FROM retention_rates
)
SELECT DISTINCT q.state
FROM qualifying q
WHERE q.all_nonzero = 1
  AND q.state IN (
    SELECT q2.state
    FROM qualifying q2
    WHERE q2.all_nonzero = 1
    GROUP BY q2.state
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT q2.gender) = 2
  )
ORDER BY q.state

WITH customer_first_payment AS (

        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) as first_payment
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_payments_with_hours AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        p.amount,
        p.payment_date,
        cfp.first_payment,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cfp.first_payment)) / 3600.0 as hours_since_first
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_first_payment cfp ON p.customer_id = cfp.customer_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        first_payment,
        SUM(amount) as total_ltv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN hours_since_first >= 0 AND hours_since_first <= 168 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_7days,
        SUM(CASE WHEN hours_since_first >= 0 AND hours_since_first <= 720 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_30days
    FROM customer_payments_with_hours
    GROUP BY customer_id, first_payment
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN total_ltv > 0 THEN 100.0 * ltv_7days / total_ltv ELSE NULL END), 2) as avg_pct_7days,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN total_ltv > 0 THEN 100.0 * ltv_30days / total_ltv ELSE NULL END), 2) as avg_pct_30days,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN total_ltv > 0 THEN total_ltv ELSE NULL END), 2) as avg_ltv
FROM customer_metrics

    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id

),
film_actor_share AS (

    FROM film_actor fa
    JOIN film_revenue fr ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,

    FROM film_actor_share
),
top3 AS (

    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn <= 3
)

    a.actor_id,

    f.title,

    t3.rn as film_rank,

FROM top3 t3

JOIN film f ON t3.film_id = f.film_id

-- Final query with proper month formatting
WITH top10 AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) as total_paid
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
    ORDER BY total_paid DESC

),
monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) as payment_month, SUM(p.amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment p
    WHERE p.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top10)
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT customer_id, payment_month, monthly_total,
           LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_month_total,
           LAG(payment_month) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_month
    FROM monthly_payments
),
consecutive AS (
    SELECT customer_id, prev_month, payment_month, monthly_total, prev_month_total,
           ROUND(monthly_total - prev_month_total, 2) as month_over_month_diff
    FROM with_prev
    WHERE prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
      AND payment_month = prev_month + INTERVAL '1' MONTH
)
SELECT cu.customer_id,
       cu.first_name || ' ' || cu.last_name as customer_name,
       CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cp.payment_month) AS VARCHAR) || '-' || 
       LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cp.payment_month) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') as month,
       cp.month_over_month_diff
FROM consecutive cp
JOIN customer cu ON cp.customer_id = cu.customer_id
ORDER BY cp.month_over_month_diff DESC

WITH filtered_words AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words
  FROM word_list
  WHERE words IS NOT NULL 
    AND words != ''
    AND LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
    AND words LIKE 'r%'
),
word_chars AS (
  SELECT fw.words, 
    string_agg(substring(fw.words, gs.unnest, 1), '' ORDER BY substring(fw.words, gs.unnest, 1)) as sorted_chars
  FROM filtered_words fw
  CROSS JOIN unnest(generate_series(1, 5)) as gs
  WHERE gs.unnest <= length(fw.words)
  GROUP BY fw.words
),
anagram_groups AS (
  SELECT sorted_chars, COUNT(*) as anagram_count
  FROM word_chars
  GROUP BY sorted_chars
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT wc.words, ag.anagram_count
FROM word_chars wc
JOIN anagram_groups ag ON wc.sorted_chars = ag.sorted_chars
ORDER BY wc.words
LIMIT 10

WITH top10_states AS (

    GROUP BY state
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
state_stats AS (

           SUM(CASE WHEN ad.aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as friendly_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ad.aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hostile_count,
           COUNT(*) as total_count,
           AVG(ad.age) as avg_age
    FROM alien_data ad
    JOIN top10_states t10 ON ad.state = t10.state
    GROUP BY ad.state
)
SELECT state,
       friendly_count,
       hostile_count,
       total_count,
       1.0 * friendly_count / total_count * 100 as friendly_pct,

SELECT

  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) 
   FROM orders o 
   JOIN deliveries d ON o.order_id = d.delivery_order_id 
   WHERE o.store_id = s.store_id AND d.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED') as delivered_order_count,
  1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) 
   FROM orders o 
   JOIN deliveries d ON o.order_id = d.delivery_order_id 
   WHERE o.store_id = s.store_id AND d.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED') 
  / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.store_id = s.store_id) as delivered_ratio
FROM stores s
WHERE s.store_id = (
    SELECT o.store_id
    FROM orders o
    GROUP BY o.store_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT 
    s.hub_id,
    h.hub_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as feb_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mar_orders,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE 1.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100
    END as pct_increase
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN hubs h ON s.hub_id = h.hub_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
  AND o.order_created_month IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY s.hub_id, h.hub_name
HAVING pct_increase > 20
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC

-- Calculate the median of the highest season goals per team
-- Using PERCENTILE_CONT for median
WITH team_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        season,
        SUM(home_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id, season
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        season,
        SUM(away_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY away_team_api_id, season
),
team_season_totals AS (
    SELECT team_api_id, season, SUM(total_goals) AS season_total
    FROM team_season_goals
    GROUP BY team_api_id, season
),
team_max_season AS (
    SELECT team_api_id, MAX(season_total) AS max_season_goals
    FROM team_season_totals
    GROUP BY team_api_id
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY max_season_goals) AS median_highest_season_goals
FROM team_max_season;

WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        l.name as league_name,
        l.id as league_id,
        t.team_long_name,
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_win
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        l.name as league_name,
        l.id as league_id,
        t.team_long_name,
        CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_win
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_name,
        league_id,
        team_long_name,
        CAST(SUM(is_win) AS INTEGER) as total_wins
    FROM team_matches
    GROUP BY league_name, league_id, team_long_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        league_name,
        team_long_name,
        total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league_name ORDER BY total_wins ASC, team_long_name ASC) as rn
    FROM team_wins
)
SELECT league_name, team_long_name, total_wins
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league_name

WITH team_home_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    t.team_long_name,
    t.team_api_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
  FROM Match m
  JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
  GROUP BY t.team_long_name, t.team_api_id
),
team_away_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    t.team_long_name,
    t.team_api_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
  FROM Match m
  JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
  GROUP BY t.team_long_name, t.team_api_id
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(h.team_long_name, a.team_long_name) AS team_long_name,
  CAST(COALESCE(h.wins, 0) + COALESCE(a.wins, 0) AS INTEGER) AS total_wins
FROM team_home_wins h
FULL OUTER JOIN team_away_wins a 
  ON h.team_api_id = a.team_api_id
ORDER BY total_wins DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH ball_data AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id, striker, non_striker,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY over_id, ball_id) as rn
    FROM ball_by_ball
),
with_pair AS (
    SELECT *,
           LEAST(striker, non_striker) as bat1,
           GREATEST(striker, non_striker) as bat2
    FROM ball_data
),
with_pair_change AS (
    SELECT *,
           CASE WHEN (bat1 = LAG(bat1) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY rn) 
                   AND bat2 = LAG(bat2) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY rn))
                THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as pair_changed
    FROM with_pair
),
with_segment AS (
    SELECT *,
           SUM(pair_changed) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY rn) as segment_id
    FROM with_pair_change
),
segment_runs AS (
    SELECT ws.match_id, ws.innings_no, ws.segment_id,
           ws.bat1 as player1, ws.bat2 as player2,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ws.striker = ws.bat1 THEN COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) ELSE 0 END) as player1_score,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ws.striker = ws.bat2 THEN COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) ELSE 0 END) as player2_score,
           SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as partnership_runs
    FROM with_segment ws
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON ws.match_id = bs.match_id AND ws.over_id = bs.over_id AND ws.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND ws.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY ws.match_id, ws.innings_no, ws.segment_id, ws.bat1, ws.bat2
),
max_partnership AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) as max_runs
    FROM segment_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT sr.match_id, sr.player1, sr.player2, sr.player1_score, sr.player2_score, sr.partnership_runs
    FROM segment_runs sr
    JOIN max_partnership mp ON sr.match_id = mp.match_id AND sr.partnership_runs = mp.max_runs
)
SELECT match_id, player1, player2, player1_score, player2_score, partnership_runs
FROM qualified
WHERE match_id = 392207
ORDER BY match_id, partnership_runs DESC

    SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as total_matches

player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker as player_id, b.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_runs

    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no

    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON wt.match_id = b.match_id AND wt.over_id = b.over_id AND wt.ball_id = b.ball_id AND wt.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
player_runs_conceded AS (

        JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no

    )
    WHERE rn = 1

SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    COALESCE(mfr.role, 'Player') as most_frequent_role,

LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON p.player_id = pd.player_id

-- Final answer: problems where qualifying count exceeds solution count
WITH stack_comparison AS (
    SELECT name, version, step,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as stack_score,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE step IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY name, version, step
    HAVING stack_score IS NOT NULL
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT name, version, step
    FROM stack_comparison
    WHERE max_non_stack_score < stack_score
),
qualified_count AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as qualified_count
    FROM qualified
    GROUP BY name
),
solution_count AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as solution_count
    FROM solution
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT q.name
FROM qualified_count q
JOIN solution_count s ON q.name = s.name
WHERE q.qualified_count > s.solution_count
ORDER BY q.name

WITH stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, test_score AS stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack'
),
non_stack_max AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, MAX(test_score) AS max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack'
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
step_statuses AS (
    SELECT ss.name, ss.version, ss.step,
           CASE WHEN nsm.max_non_stack_score < ss.stack_score THEN 'strong'
                WHEN nsm.max_non_stack_score = ss.stack_score THEN 'soft'
                ELSE 'other' END AS step_status
    FROM stack_scores ss
    JOIN non_stack_max nsm ON ss.name = nsm.name AND ss.version = nsm.version AND ss.step = nsm.step
),
model_has_status AS (
    SELECT name, version,
           MAX(CASE WHEN step_status = 'strong' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_strong,
           MAX(CASE WHEN step_status = 'soft' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_soft
    FROM step_statuses
    GROUP BY name, version
),
model_l1_status AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ms.name, ms.version,
           m.L1_model,
           CASE WHEN ms.has_strong = 1 THEN 'strong' ELSE NULL END AS status1,
           CASE WHEN ms.has_soft = 1 THEN 'soft' ELSE NULL END AS status2
    FROM model_has_status ms
    JOIN model m ON ms.name = m.name AND ms.version = m.version
),
unpivoted AS (
    SELECT name, version, L1_model, status1 AS status FROM model_l1_status WHERE status1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT name, version, L1_model, status2 AS status FROM model_l1_status WHERE status2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT status, L1_model, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM unpivoted
GROUP BY status, L1_model
ORDER BY status, cnt DESC
SELECT L1_model, COUNT(*) as total_count FROM model GROUP BY L1_model ORDER BY total_count DESC

-- Now I need to calculate the total quantity per root packaging combination, then find the average across all combinations.
-- Total per combination = sum of all leaf quantities for that root

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS root_id,
        p.id AS current_id,
        p.name AS current_name,
        1 AS depth,
        CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS running_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        pn.name,
        pt.depth + 1,
        pt.running_qty * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
    JOIN packaging pn ON pn.id = pr.contains_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pt.current_id,
        pt.current_name,
        pt.running_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    WHERE pt.current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
leaf_aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(running_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM leaf_items
    GROUP BY root_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(1.0 * total_leaf_qty) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM leaf_aggregated

-- Aggregate total quantities per top-level container per leaf item
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id AS top_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS total_qty_so_far
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (531, 532, 533, 534)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        h.total_qty_so_far * pr.qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_id
)
SELECT 
    p_top.name AS top_container,
    p_leaf.name AS leaf_item,
    SUM(h.total_qty_so_far) AS total_qty
FROM hierarchy h
JOIN packaging p_top ON p_top.id = h.top_id
JOIN packaging p_leaf ON p_leaf.id = h.current_id
WHERE h.current_id IN (501, 502)
GROUP BY p_top.name, p_leaf.name
HAVING SUM(h.total_qty_so_far) > 500
ORDER BY p_top.name, p_leaf.name

WITH order_products AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS total_needed
    FROM orderlines 
    WHERE order_id = 423
    GROUP BY product_id
),
inventory_sorted AS (
    SELECT inv.id, inv.product_id, inv.purchase_id, inv.qty, inv.location_id, p.purchased, l.warehouse, l.aisle, l.position,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, inv.qty, inv.id) AS rn
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN purchases p ON inv.purchase_id = p.id
    JOIN locations l ON inv.location_id = l.id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
      AND inv.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_products)
),
with_cum AS (
    SELECT inv.*, op.total_needed,
           SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.rn ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_qty,
           COALESCE(SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS prev_cum
    FROM inventory_sorted inv
    JOIN order_products op ON inv.product_id = op.product_id
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, 
       CASE 
           WHEN prev_cum >= total_needed THEN 0
           WHEN prev_cum + qty <= total_needed THEN qty
           ELSE total_needed - prev_cum
       END AS qty_to_pick
FROM with_cum
WHERE prev_cum < total_needed
ORDER BY product_id, rn

-- Final query: average pick percentage per product name
WITH order_cumulative AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id, ol.product_id, p.name as product_name, ol.qty as order_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered, ol.id) as order_rank,
           COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered, ol.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) as prev_cum_demand
    FROM orderlines ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as total_inv
    FROM inventory_with_dims
    GROUP BY product_id
),
with_allocation AS (
    SELECT 
        oc.product_id,
        oc.product_name,
        oc.order_qty,
        oc.order_rank,
        pt.total_inv,
        1.0 * LEAST(oc.order_qty, GREATEST(0, pt.total_inv - oc.prev_cum_demand)) / oc.order_qty as pick_pct
    FROM order_cumulative oc
    JOIN product_totals pt ON oc.product_id = pt.product_id
)
SELECT product_name, 
       AVG(pick_pct) as avg_pick_pct
FROM with_allocation
GROUP BY product_name
ORDER BY product_name

WITH monthly_data AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) as month_num
    FROM monthly_sales
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty, month_num,
           AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_num ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 6 FOLLOWING) as window1_avg,
           AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY month_num ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) as window2_avg
    FROM monthly_data
),
ratio_calc AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty, month_num,
           (window1_avg + window2_avg) / 2.0 as cma,
           qty / ((window1_avg + window2_avg) / 2.0) as sales_ratio
    FROM cma_calc
),
products_2017 AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           MIN(sales_ratio) as min_ratio
    FROM ratio_calc
    WHERE month_num BETWEEN 7 AND 30
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mth::DATE) = 2017
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id, p.name
FROM products_2017 pr
JOIN products p ON p.id = pr.product_id
WHERE pr.min_ratio > 2;

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT product_id, mth, qty,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS time_step,
         CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(mth AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) AS month_num
  FROM monthly_sales
  WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
cma_7_30 AS (
  SELECT s1.product_id, s1.time_step, s1.mth, s1.qty, s1.month_num,
         (SELECT AVG(s2.qty * 1.0) 
          FROM sales s2 
          WHERE s2.product_id = s1.product_id 
            AND s2.time_step BETWEEN s1.time_step - 5 AND s1.time_step + 6
         ) AS cma1,
         (SELECT AVG(s2.qty * 1.0) 
          FROM sales s2 
          WHERE s2.product_id = s1.product_id 
            AND s2.time_step BETWEEN s1.time_step - 6 AND s1.time_step + 5
         ) AS cma2
  FROM sales s1
  WHERE s1.time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
with_cma AS (
  SELECT product_id, time_step, mth, qty, month_num,
         (cma1 + cma2) / 2.0 AS cma_val,
         CASE WHEN (cma1 + cma2) / 2.0 != 0 THEN qty / ((cma1 + cma2) / 2.0) ELSE NULL END AS sales_to_cma_ratio
  FROM cma_7_30
),
seasonal_avg AS (
  SELECT product_id, month_num, AVG(sales_to_cma_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM with_cma
  GROUP BY product_id, month_num
),
seasonal_normalized AS (
  SELECT product_id, month_num, 
         avg_ratio / (SUM(avg_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) / 12.0) AS seasonal_index
  FROM seasonal_avg
),
deseasonalized_all AS (
  SELECT s.product_id, s.time_step, s.mth, s.qty, s.month_num,
         sn.seasonal_index,
         s.qty / NULLIF(sn.seasonal_index, 0) AS deseasonalized_qty
  FROM sales s
  JOIN seasonal_normalized sn ON s.month_num = sn.month_num AND s.product_id = sn.product_id
),
valid_data AS (
  SELECT da.product_id, da.time_step, da.qty, da.month_num, da.seasonal_index, da.deseasonalized_qty,
         wc.cma_val
  FROM deseasonalized_all da
  LEFT JOIN with_cma wc ON da.product_id = wc.product_id AND da.time_step = wc.time_step
  WHERE da.deseasonalized_qty IS NOT NULL
    AND wc.cma_val IS NOT NULL
),
weighted_stats AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         SUM(cma_val) AS sum_w,
         SUM(cma_val * time_step) AS sum_wx,
         SUM(cma_val * deseasonalized_qty) AS sum_wy,
         SUM(cma_val * time_step * time_step) AS sum_wxx,
         SUM(cma_val * time_step * deseasonalized_qty) AS sum_wxy
  FROM valid_data
  GROUP BY product_id
),
weighted_regression AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         (sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy / sum_w) / (sum_wxx - sum_wx * sum_wx / sum_w) AS slope,
         sum_wy / sum_w - (sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy / sum_w) / (sum_wxx - sum_wx * sum_wx / sum_w) * sum_wx / sum_w AS intercept
  FROM weighted_stats
),
forecast AS (
  SELECT s.product_id, s.time_step, s.mth, s.month_num,
         wr.slope, wr.intercept, sn.seasonal_index,
         (wr.slope * s.time_step + wr.intercept) * sn.seasonal_index AS forecast_monthly
  FROM sales s
  JOIN weighted_regression wr ON s.product_id = wr.product_id
  JOIN seasonal_normalized sn ON s.month_num = sn.month_num AND s.product_id = sn.product_id
  WHERE s.time_step BETWEEN 25 AND 36
)
SELECT product_id, 
       SUM(forecast_monthly) AS forecasted_annual_2018,
       ROUND(SUM(forecast_monthly), 2) AS rounded_annual
FROM forecast
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id

WITH weekly_totals AS (

    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_year, week_number

with_period AS (

        CASE 
            WHEN TRY_CAST(week_start AS DATE) < CAST(TRY_CAST(calendar_year AS VARCHAR) || '-06-15' AS DATE) THEN 'pre'
            WHEN TRY_CAST(week_start AS DATE) > CAST(TRY_CAST(calendar_year AS VARCHAR) || '-06-15' AS DATE) THEN 'post'
        END as period
    FROM weekly_totals
    WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        week_number,
        week_start,
        total_sales,
        period,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY calendar_year, period 
            ORDER BY 
                CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN TRY_CAST(week_start AS DATE) END DESC,
                CASE WHEN period = 'post' THEN TRY_CAST(week_start AS DATE) END ASC
        ) as rn
    FROM with_period
    WHERE period IS NOT NULL
),
selected AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        period,
        SUM(total_sales) as period_sales
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn <= 4
    GROUP BY calendar_year, period
),
summary AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN period_sales ELSE 0 END) as pre_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'post' THEN period_sales ELSE 0 END) as post_sales
    FROM selected
    GROUP BY calendar_year
)

    FROM drives
),
driver_constructor_points AS (
    SELECT dc.year, dc.constructor_id, dc.driver_id, dcp.driver_points, cfp.constructor_points
    FROM driver_constructor dc
    JOIN driver_final_points dcp ON dc.driver_id = dcp.driver_id AND dc.year = dcp.year
    JOIN constructor_final_points cfp ON dc.constructor_id = cfp.constructor_id AND dc.year = cfp.year
    WHERE dcp.driver_points IS NOT NULL AND cfp.constructor_points IS NOT NULL
),
best_driver_per_con AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, driver_points, constructor_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, constructor_id ORDER BY driver_points DESC) as rn
    FROM driver_constructor_points
)
SELECT c.name as constructor_name, bdc.year, bdc.driver_points + bdc.constructor_points as combined_points
FROM best_driver_per_con bdc
JOIN constructors c ON bdc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE bdc.rn = 1
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Final query: list all unique drivers who meet the criteria
WITH driver_seasons AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, 
           MIN(first_round) as overall_first_round,
           MAX(last_round) as overall_last_round
    FROM drives
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
first_race_constructors AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.driver_id, d.constructor_id
    FROM drives d
    JOIN driver_seasons ds ON d.year = ds.year AND d.driver_id = ds.driver_id
    WHERE d.first_round = ds.overall_first_round
),
last_race_constructors AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.driver_id, d.constructor_id
    FROM drives d
    JOIN driver_seasons ds ON d.year = ds.year AND d.driver_id = ds.driver_id
    WHERE d.last_round = ds.overall_last_round
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname
FROM first_race_constructors f
JOIN last_race_constructors l ON f.year = l.year AND f.driver_id = l.driver_id
JOIN driver_seasons ds ON f.year = ds.year AND f.driver_id = ds.driver_id
JOIN drivers d ON f.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE f.constructor_id = l.constructor_id
  AND ds.overall_last_round - ds.overall_first_round >= 1
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename

-- Final query with more precision
WITH driver_drives AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY first_round) as rn
    FROM drives
    WHERE constructor_id != -1
),
consecutive AS (
    SELECT a.year, a.driver_id, a.rn as rn1, a.first_round as first_round1, a.last_round as last_round1, a.constructor_id as constructor1,
           b.first_round as first_round2, b.last_round as last_round2, b.constructor_id as constructor2
    FROM driver_drives a
    JOIN driver_drives b ON a.year = b.year AND a.driver_id = b.driver_id AND a.rn = b.rn - 1
),
hiatuses AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, last_round1, first_round2, (first_round2 - last_round1 - 1) as races_missed,
           constructor1, constructor2, constructor1 != constructor2 as switched,
           last_round1 + 1 as first_missed_round,
           first_round2 - 1 as last_missed_round
    FROM consecutive
    WHERE first_round2 > last_round1 + 1
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(first_missed_round), 4) as avg_first_round,
    ROUND(AVG(last_missed_round), 4) as avg_last_round,
    COUNT(*) as num_instances
FROM hiatuses
WHERE races_missed < 3 AND switched
